name: US passport
fullName: US passport photo for online renewal
intro: Renewing a US passport online needs a square digital photo within a pixel range and a file size range. It's the same 2 × 2 inch shape as a printed passport photo.

documents.label: Passport photo
notes: Square photo between 600 × 600 and 1200 × 1200 pixels, between 54 KB and 10 MB.
Plain white or off-white background, facing the camera, neutral expression, no glasses.

source.label: Summary of US Department of State online renewal photo rules (photo-requirements site; confirm on travel.state.gov)

faqs.q: What size is a digital US passport photo?
faqs.a: Square, between 600 × 600 and 1200 × 1200 pixels, with a file size between 54 KB and 10 MB.

faqs.q: Can I take my US passport photo with my phone?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as it meets the rules: plain light background, even light, facing the camera, no glasses. Ask someone else to take it rather than using a selfie.
